name: jet-fighters
description: Browser replica of the 1979 Gakken/CGL Jet Fighters tabletop VFD game

scripts.model:render: sh tools/model/blender.sh --out public/models/console.glb --render /tmp/console-render && python3 tools/model/compare.py front /tmp/console-render/console-model-front.png docs/evidence/console-model-front.jpg && python3 tools/model/compare.py board /tmp/console-render/console-model-board.png docs/evidence/console-model-board.jpg
